title: Canva for athletes
why: Sponsors and scouts look you up online. A consistent, professional presence turns performances into opportunities.
what_is_different: Athlete content follows the season: match-day graphics, results, highlight reels and sponsor posts — made fast, on a phone, often between training sessions.
